reviews.text: D&G always give the best groom for my Maltese, thank you!

This is the first time I have used Diana and Goerge, and also the first time I have been really happy with the result. They totally listened to what I wanted, I have to say I think it's the best he has looked,  I did initially think they were a tad expensive, but once I went back and saw him, I realised it was worth every penny, he was really happy, they also picked up on a few things that need a vet visit.
Thank you Diana and George, for doing such good job with a personal feel.
I will be back, in fact I rebooked already 🤩.

Thank you Diana & George for making my baby Lily beautiful. I couldn’t wish for the most  caring groomers. My Lily is always beautifully groomed and happy when I collect her. The best groomers in Battersea. 🙏🏻❤️ …

Diana & George are truly miracle groomers—highly experienced, incredibly skilled, and deeply understanding of both dogs and their owners'.  My little dog is reactive and anxious, absolutely dreading being brushed or groomed.  But as a poodle mix, regular grooming is a must.

When I took him to Diana & George and explained his temperament, I honestly expected them to turn us away.  Instead, they kindly agreed to give it a try.  I left my doggie there, half expecting a call within five minutes asking me to come collect him.  To my surprise, that call didn’t come for an hour and a half—when they call me letting me know that he was ready.  When I arrived he was beautifully groomed 🤩 and, more importantly, happy!  ❤️

They took their time, gave my doggie a space, and worked entirely at his pace.  I’m beyond grateful to have found Diana & George and couldn’t recommend them highly enough, especially for nervous and reactive pups and their owners.
10/10 🌟
